title: Express containment as nesting, never as drawn edges
context: Alternative approaches: draw containment edges alongside dependency edges (draws clutter); use hierarchical layouts that show both relations.
decision: Schematify expresses the containment relation (strict tree of parent nodes) through visual nesting only. Containment is never drawn as a line. The rule is: `contains = nesting · depends_on = drawn`.
consequences: Clean visual distinction between structural and behavioral relations; nesting is the only way to show parentage; no edge clutter from containment; users must read spatial structure instead of edge labels.
